reason: It runs on WhatsApp so I don't have to learn another app, the first month is free and I can stop by replying STOP, so I'll try the ₹999 plan. I'm not paying for the creator campaign though, I've already wasted money on likes that never turned into customers.
objection: AI captions and creator collabs sound like the same vanity metrics again: views and followers in a Sunday report don't pay my staff, I want to see actual bookings walking in.
would_change_my_mind: If after the free month the report can't show me real enquiries that turned into bookings, I cancel. Proof from another salon or gym in my area with actual bookings would get me onto the ₹2,499 plan.
